At Park Plaza Amsterdam Airport, our Food & Beverage operation delivers much more than day-to-day service. From individual guests and crew meals to conferences, banquets, weddings and gala dinners, no two days are the same.

We're looking for a motivated and flexible Waiter / Waitress who enjoys variety, learns quickly, and feels comfortable supporting both small and large-scale Food & Beverage operations. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow in a dynamic hotel environment and gain exposure to à la carte service, banqueting, conferences and events.

What You'll Be Doing?
As Waiter / Waitress, you'll support the Food & Beverage team in daily service operations, remaining hands-on across outlets, service styles and event setups.
You will:

• Deliver friendly, efficient service during breakfast, lunch, dinner and events

• Support service for banquets, buffets, conferences and private functions

• Work across multiple outlets, including restaurant, bar and event spaces

• Take orders, serve food and drinks, and ensure correct timing and presentation

• Set up, maintain and clear service areas according to hotel standards

• Ensure guest satisfaction by anticipating needs and responding professionally

• Follow hygiene, safety, cash handling and service procedures

• Support the team during busy services with a flexible, can-do attitude

• Step in where needed and continue developing your service skills

This Role Is Right for You If You:

• Have previous experience in Food & Beverage service or hospitality

• Enjoy working with guests and creating positive, memorable experiences

• Are eager to learn and grow within a professional hotel environment

• Enjoy variety and working in a fast-paced, operational setting

• Stay calm, organised and guest-focused during busy services

• Take pride in teamwork, standards and attention to detail

• Feel comfortable communicating in English (Dutch is an advantage)

Why Join Park Plaza Amsterdam Airport?

Do you want to work as a logistics employee in Tilburg and earn between €3.000,- and €3.300,- gross per month? Are you looking for an active 2-shift job where you do more than only move boxes from A to B? In this role, you prepare food products for shipment, repack orders, check labels and register everything correctly in the system. You work between logistics and production, so your shift stays varied and practical. Together with your colleagues, you make sure every order is checked, packed and ready on time for customers worldwide.

Functieomschrijving:
As a logistics employee in Tilburg, you work between the warehouse and production. You prepare cheese products for shipment, register orders in the system and keep materials moving through the process. The work is active and physically demanding. In general, your tasks are:
• Collecting, repacking and preparing customer orders for shipment.
• Manually lifting, moving and turning products weighing approximately 15 kilograms.
• Placing products into packaging and preparing them for the next production step.
• Checking labels, packaging, quantities, weights and product quality.
• Registering products and orders correctly using scanners and warehouse systems.
• Loading and unloading trucks and checking incoming and outgoing goods.
• Moving products with a pump truck and, when applicable, a forklift or reach truck.
• Working in a refrigerated area for part of the shift when required.
• Reporting deviations and working safely and hygienically according to HACCP guidelines.

Functievereisten:
This role fits someone who enjoys practical logistics work and can stay accurate during a busy shift. You do not need to know the full process yet, but you must be able to follow procedures and handle physical work.
• Experience in logistics, production, order picking or warehouse work.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule.
• Good command of English.
• Able to regularly lift and move products of around 15 kilograms.
